5a866ee3a287.reason: This error affects 0 distinct real users (only HeadlessChrome, port 4173 = vite preview, likely a CI E2E test run). The root cause is "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useRef')" from React's internal dispatcher — this is a classic dual React instance problem where two separate copies of React are loaded (the renderer and the hooks share different ReactCurrentDispatcher objects). The application code in useAnchoredPosition.js and NotificationPopover.jsx correctly follows all React rules of hooks. Fixing this requires build/bundling configuration changes (deduplicating React in the Vite config or pnpm overrides), which are off-limits per the hard rules. No surgical, low-risk source-code-only fix is available.
